english: Method: KA2 participants matched to the school registry by name and postcode; the 51 matches that were not exact were checked by hand. Expected = each county’s schools × the national rate for its school type. 95 % ranges are Wilson intervals. KA1 mobility is not included, so a school active only in KA1 counts as not taking part. Kindergartens have their own filter and are not part of “Primary + secondary”.
